newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Manila's Premiere a speculative buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Manila's Premiere a speculative buy.

text.p: Manila brokerage firm Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc on Monday recommended a speculative buy rating on the initial public offering (IPO) of Premiere Entertaiment Productions Inc.
In a research report, the broker cited declining revenues of movie firms and stiff competition with cable TV and foreign films as reasons for its rating on the movie and television producer.
Premiere is planning to offer 180 million shares to the public at a par value of one peso starting April 2 to May 7.

"Premiere is faced with a lot of problems. Movie receipts per movie right now are on the decline brought about by the proliferation of foreign films," said Anscor analyst April Bautista in the report.

Bautista said that two of the largest movie companies posted losses last year. "It is very hard to gauge what will click with the moviegoing public. Not even the presence of big names in the movies guarantees the film's success," the securities firm added.
Premiere said that proceeds of the IPO will be used to cover the production of motion pictures and television shows as well as the acquisition of production and filming equipment.
